title: No payment closed handler for topup / wallet_topup: unpaid PromptPay/slip payments never expire and the order queue keeps stale รอชำระเงิน / รอตรวจสลิป rows forever
steps: 1) In-process: import apps/web/src/modules then paymentHookSummary(). 2) SQL: select ref_type,status,expires_at from payments where tenant_id=demo-topup and ref_type in ('topup','wallet_topup') and status in ('pending','pending_verification') and expires_at < now()-interval '15 minutes'.
expected: registerPaymentClosedHandler('topup', …) (and 'wallet_topup') so expireStalePayments sweeps 30-min PromptPay payments → payment expired, order cancelled (and wallet_topups row closed), as commerce/booking/rental/events do.
actual: paymentHookSummary().closed = [order, booking, patient_package, rest_order, reservation, stay, ticket_order] — topup and wallet_topup missing. DB: 1 topup payment status pending_verification with expires_at 2026-10-16 09:12 UTC still open on 2026-10-19 (order TP-? placed 2026-10-16 08:42 still pending_payment). Admin order page prints 'หมดอายุ <date>' next to a payment that is still open; customer can still upload a slip into it days later.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/topup_admin-db.ts all → paymentHookSummary {"closed":["order","booking","patient_package","rest_order","reservation","stay","ticket_order"]}; 'open topup/wallet_topup payments past expires_at' → topup pending_verification n=1 oldest_expiry 2026-10-16 09:12:31+00; 'pending_payment topup orders by age' → n=1 oldest 2026-10-16 08:42
suggestedFix: Add registerPaymentClosedHandler('topup', onTopupPaymentClosed) that cancels the order when it is still pending_payment and payment.id === topup_orders.payment_id (emit topup.cancelled), and one for 'wallet_topup' that marks the wallet_topups row expired/cancelled; have adminCancelOrder call cancelPayment(..., { runHandler: false }).

title: Proof-of-delivery / game image upload trusts the client's file.type (no sniffImage): SVG and HTML renamed .png are stored and served as images
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/topup/_shared.ts:20-26 storeImage (IMAGE_MIMES.has(file.type), content type = file.type); used by topup/orders/actions.ts:105 uploadProofAction and topup/games/actions.ts:53 uploadGameImageAction. Reference: products/actions.ts:85, events/actions.ts:126, rental/units/actions.ts:89 all sniffImage(buf).

expected: Rejected like every other module ('รองรับเฉพาะไฟล์รูปภาพ JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF' decided by magic bytes); stored extension/content type derived from the sniffed kind.
actual: (a) svg accepted=true url=http://localhost:3001/uploads/tenants/01a1401c-b9af-71d6-8837-f2f2f33a2579/topup-proof/1792347349322-niXoXqGr5ZECnxD4.svg fetched={"status":404,"ct":"text/html; charset=utf-8","body":"<!DOCTYPE html><html lang=\"th\" class=\"prompt_36c1cbfb-module__gCxbYa__variable ibm_plex_sans_thai_56b4564f-module__RKmm5"}; (b) html-as-png accepted=true url=http://localhost:3001/uploads/tenants/01a1401c-b9af-71d6-8837-f2f2f33a2579/topup-proof/1792347352222-e6hGNiU_PMsjQBik.png fetched={"status":404,"ct":"text/html; charset=utf-8","body":"<!DOCTYPE html><html lang=\"th\" class=\"prompt_36c1cbfb-module__gCxbYa__variable ibm_plex_sans_thai_56b4564f-module__RKmm5"}; (c) gif accepted=true. The URL is then saved on the order (proofImage) and emitted in topup.fulfilled.
evidence: [{"name":"proof.svg","accepted":true,"url":"http://localhost:3001/uploads/tenants/01a1401c-b9af-71d6-8837-f2f2f33a2579/topup-proof/1792347349322-niXoXqGr5ZECnxD4.svg","fetched":{"status":404,"ct":"text/html; charset=utf-8","body":"<!DOCTYPE html><html lang=\"th\" class=\"prompt_36c1cbfb-module__gCxbYa__variable ibm_plex_sans_thai_56b4564f-module__RKmm5"}},{"name":"proof.png","accepted":true,"url":"http://localhost:3001/uploads/tenants/01a1401c-b9af-71d6-8837-f2f2f33a2579/topup-proof/1792347352222-e6hGNiU_PMsjQBik.png","fetched":{"status":404,"ct":"text/html; charset=utf-8","body":"<!DOCTYPE html><html lang=\"th\" class=\"prompt_36c1cbfb-module__gCxbYa__variable ibm_plex_sans_thai_56b4564f-module__RKmm5"}},{"name":"proof.gif","accepted":true,"url":"http://localhost:3001/uploads/tenants/01a1401c-b9af-71d6-8837-f2f2f33a2579/topup-proof/1792347353235-lIUZGTUfASNg7B18.gif","fetched":{"status":404,"ct":"text/html; charset=utf-8","body":"<!DOCTYPE html><html lang=\"th\" class=\"prompt_36c1cbfb-module__gCxbYa__variable ibm_plex_sans_thai_56b4564f-module__RKmm5"}}] | static: file:line above; static (admin dev server was down when probed — dynamic confirmation pending in topup_admin-probes.ts p1). | web host serves the stored file: curl -H 'Host: demo-topup.localhost' http://127.0.0.1:3000/uploads/tenants/01a1401c…/topup-proof/1792347349322-niXoXqGr5ZECnxD4.svg → 200 image/svg+xml (149 bytes, the <svg><script> payload); proof.png (HTML bytes) and proof.gif (bogus bytes) were accepted the same way.
suggestedFix: In storeImage: const buf = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer()); const kind = sniffImage(buf); if (!kind) return error; put(objectKey(tenantId, folder, `x.${kind.ext}`), buf, kind.mime). Also validate fulfillSchema.proofImage is a URL under the tenant's upload prefix rather than any string.

title: failOrderAction accepts an UNPAID order: it becomes เติมไม่สำเร็จ while its PromptPay payment stays open, and money paid afterwards is accepted with no fulfilment and no refund flag
where: packages/modules/topup/src/admin/orders.ts:339-359 adminFailOrder (only blocks fulfilled/failed/refunded/cancelled; pending_payment passes), apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/topup/orders/actions.ts:36 failOrderAction; the UI hides the button (order-actions.tsx:78) but the FailDialog copy even has an 'unpaid' branch (order-actions.tsx:200).
steps: 1) Order TP-1057 pending_payment with PromptPay payment 01a15039-6b7a-70d6-9756-8f86a5d49516. 2) POST server action failOrderAction(slug, orderId, reason) (any manager; UI button hidden). 3) Customer opens /topup/TP-1057 and uploads a slip (strong proof → auto-approve).
expected: An unpaid order cannot be 'failed' — only cancelled through adminCancelOrder (which must void the payment with cancelPayment). If money arrives for a closed order the paid handler must return refundRequired(...) so the payment is flagged ต้องคืนเงิน and the owner notified.
actual: failOrderAction → {"ok":true,"note":"already failed in an earlier run"}; order failed, payment still pending. Slip upload → HTTP 200 {"status":"paid","slipUrl":"/uploads/tenants/01a1401c-b9af-71d6-8837-f2f2f33a2579/slips/1792347476755-L-KHHfctMfPs9h6S.p; afterwards payment=paid paid_at=2026-10-18 18:17:57.156+00 provider_payload={"number":"TP-1057"} failure_reason=null; order still failed (no refundRequired in supplier_response: null); outbox events for the payment: payment.created, payment.slip_uploaded, payment.paid — no payment.refund_required. Storefront /topup/TP-1057 meanwhile shows 'เติมไม่สำเร็จ (ทดสอบ QA: fail while unpaid) ทีมงานจะคืนเงินผ่านช่องทางเดิมภายใน 24 ชม.' — a refund promise on an order that was never paid, and after the late slip the page still says the same while the payment row is paid.
evidence: topup_admin-probes.ts p2 run 5ag0t: before order=failed/payment=pending; after fail order=failed/payment=pending; after slip payment=paid order=failed events=[payment.created,payment.slip_uploaded,payment.paid] | static: file:line above; dynamic confirmation pending (topup_admin-probes.ts p2) — admin server down at probe time.
suggestedFix: adminFailOrder: return fail(...) when order.status === 'pending_payment' (tell the admin to use ยกเลิกรายการ). services/orders.ts onTopupPaid: when order.status !== 'pending_payment' return refundRequired('รายการปิดแล้ว (' + order.status + ')') instead of silently returning, and/or registerPaymentTargetCheck('topup') treating failed as closed.

title: adminCancelOrder voids the payment with a raw UPDATE payments instead of cancelPayment(): no payment.cancelled event / audit, and failed|expired payments are flipped to cancelled against the state machine
where: packages/modules/topup/src/admin/orders.ts:399-404 (tx.update(payments).set({ status: 'cancelled' }) … status in pending, pending_verification, failed, expired); contract payments-api.md §3.2 last bullet ('not a raw UPDATE payments').
steps: Admin → ยกเลิกรายการ on unpaid order TP-1058 (cancelOrderAction).
expected: cancelPayment(tx, tenantId, paymentId, reason, { runHandler: false }) → payment cancelled + events_outbox payment.cancelled {paymentId, refType, refId, amount, reason}; expired stays expired.
actual: payments.status=cancelled, failure_reason=ทดสอบ QA cancel; events_outbox for paymentId 01a15039-8863-722a-9ea5-0428be2cadb0: [payment.created] (only the creation event) — no payment.cancelled; order events: [topup.created, topup.cancelled].
evidence: topup_admin-probes.ts p3 run 5ag0t: cancelOrderAction → {"ok":true,"message":"ยกเลิกรายการแล้ว"}; payment events after cancel = ["payment.created"] | static: file:line above; dynamic check pending (p3).
suggestedFix: Replace the raw update with await cancelPayment(tx, tenantId, order.paymentId, reason ?? 'ยกเลิกโดยแอดมิน', { runHandler: false }) guarded by isOpenPaymentStatus/failed (catch PaymentStateError for already-terminal rows).

title: rejectSlipAction only guards status=paid: on a cancelled/refunded payment markFailed throws PaymentStateError which escapes the action as an unhandled error instead of a friendly result
where: packages/modules/topup/src/admin/orders.ts:425-435 adminRejectSlip (if payment.status === 'paid' … else markFailed) vs adminApproveSlip:418 which whitelists states; contract payments-api.md §1 (markFailed from refunded/cancelled = error).

expected: { ok: false, error: 'รายการชำระเงินนี้ปิดแล้ว' } like approveSlipAction's bad_status branch.
actual: HTTP 500; RSC payload contains an error instead of a FormResult: payment 01a15039-8863-722a-9ea5-0428be2cadb0 is cancelled: cannot mark failed; approveSlipAction on the same payment correctly returns {"ok":false,"error":"สถานะการชำระเงินไม่รองรับ"}. payment stays cancelled.
evidence: topup_admin-probes.ts p3 run 5ag0t: reject → 0:{"a":"$@1","q":"","i":true,"b":"development"} 1:D"$2" 1:E{"digest":"2837995806","name":"PaymentStateError","message":"payment 01a15039-8863-722a-9ea5-0428be2cadb0 is cancelled: cannot mark failed","stack":[["markFailed","D:\\Projects\\promptcode_rentweb\\apps\\admin\\.next\\dev\\server\\chunks\\ss | static: file:line above; dynamic check pending (p3).
suggestedFix: if (!['pending','pending_verification','expired'].includes(payment.status)) return fail('รายการชำระเงินนี้ปิดแล้ว', 'bad_status'); and wrap markFailed in try/catch isPaymentStateError → fail(...).

title: Stock import only de-duplicates inside one paste: importing the same code list again (or a code already in stock / already sold) inserts duplicate available codes, so two orders get the same code
where: packages/modules/topup/src/admin/catalog.ts:332-360 importStockCodes (Set `seen` is per call; no lookup of existing code_stock rows; encryption is randomised so the DB cannot enforce uniqueness either); stock-panel import dialog has no warning.
steps: Games → Steam Wallet → สต็อกโค้ด → นำเข้าโค้ด with 'QA-DUP-5AG0T-AAAA-BBBB' → นำเข้าโค้ด again with the same line.
expected: Second import reports the code as duplicate (already in stock / already sold) and imports 0; available count unchanged.
actual: 1st import → {"ok":true,"message":"นำเข้า 1 โค้ด · พร้อมขาย 12","data":{"imported":1,"duplicates":0,"available":12}}; 2nd import of the same code → {"ok":true,"message":"นำเข้า 1 โค้ด (ตัดซ้ำ 1) · พร้อมขาย 13","data":{"imported":1,"duplicates":1,"available":13}} (counted as imported, only the in-paste repeat was dropped). code_stock now holds 2 rows whose decrypted value is 'QA-DUP-5AG0T-AAAA-BBBB' (ids 01a1503c, 01a1503c), both status=available → fulfilOrder would hand the same code to two customers and the second one is already redeemed.
evidence: topup_admin-probes.ts p4 run 5ag0t: decrypted code_stock rows = [{"id":"01a1503c-379b-76f8-9972-939800651110","status":"available","code":"QA-DUP-5AG0T-AAAA-BBBB"},{"id":"01a1503c-3ee6-76db-a8e9-3227d256852a","status":"available","code":"QA-DUP-5AG0T-AAAA-BBBB"}] | static: file:line above; dynamic confirmation pending (p4 decrypts the rows).
suggestedFix: Store a deterministic HMAC/hash of the plaintext (code_hash) with a unique index per (tenant_id, package_id or tenant-wide) and skip/flag matches on import; until then decrypt existing rows of the package in importStockCodes and drop codes that already exist (any status) reporting them as duplicates.

title: Deleting a package (or its game) with unsold code stock succeeds and the FK cascade silently destroys the encrypted codes — paid inventory lost with no warning
where: packages/modules/topup/src/admin/catalog.ts:265-271 deletePackage and :204-210 deleteGame only count topup_orders; packages/db/src/schema/topup.ts:89 code_stock.package_id ON DELETE CASCADE (:62 game_packages.game_id cascade too); confirm copy packages-manager.tsx:190 / games/[id]/page.tsx:86 does not mention stock.
steps: Games → Steam Wallet → add stock package 'QA tmp stock 5ag0t' → import 2 codes → ลบแพ็กเกจ.
expected: Refused while available/reserved codes exist ('ยังมีโค้ดในสต็อก N รายการ — void/export ก่อน') or at least a confirm that names the number of codes that will be destroyed.
actual: deletePackageAction → {"ok":true,"message":"ลบแพ็กเกจแล้ว"}; code_stock rows for the package: 2 before → 0 after (package rows 0). No audit of the destroyed codes.
evidence: topup_admin-probes.ts p4 run 5ag0t: import={"ok":true,"message":"นำเข้า 2 โค้ด · พร้อมขาย 2","data":{"imported":2,"duplicates":0,"available":2}} before=2 after=0 | static: file:line above; dynamic confirmation pending (p4).
suggestedFix: In deletePackage/deleteGame count code_stock where status in ('available','reserved') and fail('has_stock'); surface the count in the ConfirmButton description.

title: Order flagged ต้องคืนเงินมือ (failed, non-wallet) still offers ลองใหม่ as the primary button: a retry after the manual refund delivers the top-up a second time, and nothing records that the refund was already paid out
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/topup/orders/[id]/order-actions.tsx:56 retryable = fulfillment !== 'manual' && paidAt && status in [failed, processing, paid] (no refundRequired check), :68 variant 'default' when failed; page.tsx:58 shows 'กรุณาโอนคืนลูกค้า … ด้วยตนเอง แล้วบันทึกโน้ตไว้' on the same screen; packages/modules/topup/src/admin/orders.ts:362-387 adminRetryOrder accepts failed orders regardless of supplier_response.refundRequired and fulfillOrder (services/orders.ts:258) overwrites supplier_response wholesale so the refundRequired flag disappears on success.
steps: PromptPay api/stock order → เติมไม่สำเร็จ (flag ต้องคืนเงินมือ) → admin transfers the refund → later anyone clicks ลองใหม่.
expected: Retry disabled (or a confirm 'รายการนี้ติดธงคืนเงิน — ยืนยันว่ายังไม่ได้โอนคืน') and a way to record 'คืนเงินแล้ว' that clears the flag; the flag must not be silently dropped.
actual: Retry is the highlighted primary action next to the refund instruction; on success the order becomes fulfilled with the refund flag erased, so the customer can end up with both the refund and the delivered code.
suggestedFix: retryable = … && !refundRequired, or require a confirm + note; add a 'บันทึกคืนเงินแล้ว' action that stores refundedAt in supplier_response and keeps it through retries.

title: Uploaded proof / game images are stored under the ADMIN host URL, which does not serve /uploads — the preview right after upload and the saved proofImage / game image are dead links (admin and storefront)
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/topup/_shared.ts:25 `url = stored.url.startsWith('/') ? `${ADMIN_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3001'}${stored.url}` : stored.url` (comment claims 'usable by both the admin and the storefront'); contract payments-api.md §7: local storage writes ONE dir (apps/web/public/uploads), URLs stay relative '/uploads/<key>', the storefront serves them and the admin renders them through assetUrl() (apps/admin/src/lib/format.ts:56-60 → WEB_URL). Other modules return stored.url unchanged (products/actions.ts:98).
steps: Admin → order → เติมสำเร็จ → อัปโหลดรูป (any real PNG) → look at the preview thumbnail; or Games → edit game → upload image → open the storefront game grid.
expected: Preview renders; proofImage / games.image hold '/uploads/…' and are rendered via assetUrl() in the admin and as-is on the storefront host.
actual: uploadProofAction returned http://localhost:3001/uploads/tenants/01a1401c…/topup-proof/1792347349322-niXoXqGr5ZECnxD4.svg; GET on :3001 → 404 (HTML not-found page); the same key on the web host (demo-topup.localhost:3000) → 200. The dialog therefore shows a broken image, and the URL persisted on the order (and emitted in topup.fulfilled) is dead for the storefront too.
evidence: topup_admin-probes.ts p1: fetched {status:404, ct:'text/html; charset=utf-8'} for all three returned URLs; curl web host → 200 image/svg+xml; file exists at apps/web/public/uploads/tenants/…/topup-proof/1792347349322-niXoXqGr5ZECnxD4.svg
suggestedFix: Return stored.url unchanged (relative) and render with assetUrl() in admin components (FulfillDialog preview, game form preview, order detail proof image); storefront already serves /uploads.
